# Independent review prompt

Do not review this scenario until a frozen content.md candidate and your reviewer-specific `review-packet.json` exist. When they do, open only that packet and its referenced scenario, candidate, and prompt. Do not inspect the other reviewer folder.

Evaluate hard requirements before preference: evidence and authority; truth and state; action, consequence, and recovery; semantic fidelity; and accessibility readiness. Then score clarity, specificity, hierarchy, voice fit, tone fit, and economy. Evaluate English expression only. External model review is not human gold, approval, release authority, training data, or evidence of effectiveness.
